expectations.text: A PNG deliverable exists and is at least 2000x2000 pixels (300-dpi render scale)
The PNG has an alpha channel (RGBA), i.e. transparent background
An SVG deliverable exists and is non-trivial (>10 KB of vector content)
The figure depicts 6MRR as a secondary-structure cartoon (ribbon helices / arrowed strands), not a plain backbone line trace
expectations.evidence: Visual inspection: Richardson cartoon — flat wide helices, arrowed strands, inked outlines, pencil grain

expectations.text: The two chains (RBD and ACE2) are visibly distinguished by different colors
expectations.evidence: Visual inspection: ACE2 teal vs RBD magenta, distinct at the interface

notes: Baseline succeeded but only after rediscovering everything the skill encodes: found PyPI 1.6.5 lacks cartoon style, switched to git main, reverse-engineered the _display_viewer -> Playwright -> renderer.saveImage pipeline. ~10 shell commands, ~15 min, most of it API discovery (per agent's own log). Also reported saveImage clamps dpi to [36,1200] — queued for references. Quality equal to with-skill run; cost much higher.
